summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Alterity Therapeutics, a foreign private issuer, reporting data presentations on its ATH434 program for Multiple System Atrophy (MSA). It announces positive Phase 2 results and plans for an End-of-Phase 2 FDA meeting in mid-2026. The filing discusses scientific progress, not a special situation like M&A, activism, or restructuring. No deal terms, stakeholder percentages, or strategic alternatives are disclosed. As a routine operational update on clinical development, it does not fall into any special-situations category.
